summary: Guided client on the Gold Mountain Via Ferrata lost footing on a rung, fell three feet and broke her ankle on an angled rock. Two OMRT members used a wheeled litter to get her off the mountain.
location: Gold Mountain Via Ferrata, Jackass Flats exit
notes: Guided outing; patient walked to trail exit before wheeled-litter carry.
